list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat: build multimodal + trust-aware movie recommender (initial version)
Data pipeline - Add PostgreSQL + pgvector schema (movies, genres, reviews, users, movie_features, user_trust) and docker-compose setup - Load MovieLens into the database; fetch overviews and poster URLs from TMDB concurrently with retry and timeout handling - Add synthetic spam-user injection for robustness experiments
Features and scoring - Embed plot text (multilingual MiniLM) and posters (CLIP) into pgvector - Compute per-user trust from rating consistency, volume and diversity - Hybrid recommender: content similarity + trust-weighted social CF (Pearson similarity shrunk by co-rated count, damping, min support) - Add genre filter
App - Streamlit UI with user profile sidebar, new-user creation, rating tab, alpha slider and genre multiselect
Evaluation - Precision@K / Recall@K with held-out ratings masked to avoid leakage - Popularity baseline, results written to CSV
